room.gate_room.title: Gatehouse
room.gate_room.description: A gatehouse with a barred gate.
npc.guard.description: A bored guard with a ready tongue.
skill.intimidate.label: Intimidate
skill.intimidate.requirement: Anyone can try to frighten someone.
narration.guard.persuade: The guard laughs and lifts the bar.
narration.guard.intimidate: The guard flinches and lifts the bar.

narration.guard.leave: You step back from the gate.
